zh.title: About Levi
zh.paragraph: 我是 Levi，一个游走在逻辑与美学之间的创意技术人。我常与代码、交互和视觉打交道，喜欢融合不同领域的工具与思维，热衷于打造有温度的创意体验、动态设计和数字艺术，持续探寻未知的边界。

en.title: About Levi
en.paragraph: I'm Levi, a creative technologist wandering between logic and aesthetics. I work with code, interaction, and visuals — blending tools and mindsets across disciplines. I'm passionate about crafting warm creative experiences, motion design, and digital art, continually exploring unknown boundaries.
